_read_me: All of the shop's details, in one place. The website, checkout and policy pages read this file. Fill every empty field before launch; the site lists what is still missing on the policy pages.
name: Vibe X

fallback.title: 100% Original Watches | 80% Discount | New Models  | VIBE X

business._note: Shown in the footer and on the Contact page (Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020).
business.address: 3rd Floor, Mustafa Mini Complex, Govt. Girls Higher Secondary School, Khanyaar, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir 190003

policy._note: Set confirmed to true only after the owner has read and agreed the Returns, Terms and Privacy pages.
policy._photoNote: Turn on only if the shop will really send a photo of every piece on WhatsApp before dispatch. It adds that line to the promise on product pages.

courier._note: Owner's rate (2026-11-06): Rs 130 per kg outside Kashmir. PINs starting 190-193 count as Kashmir, so Jammu and Ladakh pay the rate. kg is the packed weight charged for each piece: subcategory first, then category, then default. These weights are estimates; correct them here. insideKashmir: the fee inside Kashmir, or null to confirm it on WhatsApp before dispatch.

rush._note: live: true shows the live count on product pages, the countdown on a held last piece and the 'It's yours' note. Off (owner's choice, 2026-11-06) until there are regular daily sales. The hold itself and Next in line work either way.

pay._note: Real details from the owner (2026-11-04). Bank fields empty = the Bank transfer option is hidden. Courier charge varies by location (shippingFee null = confirmed on WhatsApp before dispatch).

claims._note: Homepage numbers. Only list what the owner has confirmed is true (misleading claims break the Consumer Protection Act). Add e.g. {"big":"100,000+","small":"orders delivered"} once confirmed.
claims._ordersNote: Shown in the opening animation. Confirmed true by the owner on 2026-11-06. Delete 'orders' to hide it.
claims._deliveryNote: Shown in the opening animation. Kept consistent with policy.deliveryDays ('3 to 7' days after dispatch): say 'as fast as', not a flat promise.
ticker: Express delivery across 15K+ pincodes in India
Trusted by 2 lakh+ customers across India
claims._tickerNote: Banner lines given by the agency on 2026-11-04. Confirmed true by the owner on 2026-11-06.

billing._note: Bills from the billing portal (/billing), WhatsApp 'sold' and confirmed website orders. Vibe X is NOT GST-registered (owner confirmed 2026-11-05), so business.gstin stays empty, no GST is charged and bills say so. GST on suppliers' bills is added to cost price. If he registers: fill business.gstin and tax invoices switch on, using the rates below (have a CA check them). gstLimit: Rs 40 lakh goods turnover, the figure most sources give for J&K; a CA should confirm. It does not cover inter-state sales.
billing.headerLine: We only deal in 100% original products 🙏 Efficient delivery across India 🇮🇳
billing.terms:
1. Returns and refunds within 7 days of purchase if unused, with tags and this bill.
2. Fragrances only with the seal unbroken.
3. Full policy: vibexindia.com/returns
billing._billNote: headerLine, email, youtube and terms are copied from his myBillBook bill 7650. logo: put the image in public/ and set the path, e.g. /logo.png. terms prints on counter bills only; website-order bills point to the website returns policy instead.
